question: Under Ögedei, loans at lamb interest doubled every year. How many ingots would 1 ingot owe after 10 unpaid years?
move: Ask whether a debt adds or multiplies before agreeing to its terms.
trap: Adding one ingot a year and answering about 11.
hint: Work out five years first; ten years is five years done twice.
steps: After 5 years: 2 x 2 x 2 x 2 x 2 = 32 ingots.
reference: Allsen, Mongolian Princes and Their Merchant Partners, 1200-1260, Asia Major, third series, 2, 1989, 83-126
